classification.difficultyReason: The supplied triangle identifies the slope and angle; select sine for the vertical rise, convert kilometres to metres and round.

content.prompt: Gregor drives up a hill that is inclined at an angle of $15^\circ$ to the horizontal. If he drives for 5 km, through what vertical distance has he risen? Give your answer correct to the nearest metre.

spec.description: Horizontal base, vertical right side and rising hypotenuse; 15° at the left and a right-angle square at the lower right. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: The 5 km hypotenuse makes an angle of 15° with the horizontal; the vertical rise is opposite that angle.

answer.worked:
Let the vertical rise be $h$ metres. The distance driven is $5000\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}\sin15^\circ&=\frac{h}{5000}\\h&=5000\sin15^\circ\\h&\approx1294\text{ m}.\end{align*}$$
